title: Rendering means React calls your component

slides.say: In React, rendering means one simple thing: React calls your component function.

slides.text: Initial render: React calls the root component. Later: the component whose state changed.
slides.say: On the initial render, React calls the root component. For later renders, it calls the component whose state update triggered the render.
It is recursive. If Gallery returns Image, React calls Image next, and so on, until nothing nested is left.

slides.text: First time: create DOM nodes. Re-render: work out what changed. Always pure.
slides.say: On the first render, React creates the DOM nodes. On a re-render, it works out which properties changed. Either way, rendering must be a pure calculation.
